content.title: QDOBA joins National Burrito Day 2026 with free burritos! Here’s how you can get yours
content.text: Photo: QDOBA With National Burrito Day approaching, restaurant and fast-food chain offers are starting to pour in. QDOBA is also joining the celebration and has a surprise for all its customers: free burritos! If you want to enjoy your favorite dish without spending much, this is your chance. Here’s how and when you can redeem this promotion so you don’t miss out. ALSO READ QDOBA is giving away free queso and chips: when and how? When will QDOBA give out free burritos? The offer is exclusive to QDOBA Rewards members, so if you haven’t signed up yet, there’s still time. According to the chain, the promotion will be available only on Thursday, April 2, but Gold Status members can take advantage of it until April 5. How to get free burritos at QDOBA Redeeming the promotion is very simple: just purchase one entrée and a drink, and you’ll automatically receive another entrée for free. What is QDOBA Rewards? It’s the company’s loyalty program. You earn 1 point for every dollar spent, which you can redeem for great benefits. With 125 catering points, you get a free main dish, and for every 1000 points, you receive a $50 discount on catering or a $50 Visa gift card. The free main dish and $50 catering discount expire 60 days after redeeming the points. QDOBA Menu On the restaurant chain’s menu, you can find various items, such as: • Bowls • Nachos • Burritos • Quesadillas • Salads with a selection of proteins and a variety of ingredients • Fresh guacamole • Pico de gallo • Salsas • Prepared meals • Taco kits • Hot drinks ALSO READ Chipotle celebrates National Burrito Day with the return of its Burrito Vault game: here’s what’s new History of QDOBA Founded in 1995 as Zuma Fresh Mexican Grill in Denver, Colorado, QDOBA is a fast-casual Mexican food chain with around 800 locations in the United States, Canada, and Puerto Rico. The brand is known for using fresh ingredients, prepared daily by hand, to offer a variety of delicious options on its menu. Customers can enjoy menu items by choosing from special options prepared by chefs for convenience, or by customizing their burritos, bowls, tacos, quesadillas, nachos, and salads according to their preferences. They can also add premium ingredients, such as three-cheese queso and handmade guacamole, at no extra cost. For the sixth consecutive year, QDOBA has been recognized as the “Best Fast Casual Restaurant” in USA Today’s 10Best Readers’ Choice Awards. When is National Burrito Day 2026? National Burrito Day in 2026 will be celebrated on Thursday, April 2. The date changes every year, as it is observed on the first Thursday of April, when various restaurant chains across the United States roll out special promotions for burrito lovers. ALSO READ TacoTime Celebrates National Burrito Day 2026 with BOGO Deal Origin of National Burrito Day The origin of National Burrito Day is not fully documented, but it is believed to have started as a marketing strategy driven by restaurants and fast-food chains to promote one of the most representative dishes of Mexican cuisine in the United States. Over time, the celebration gained popularity and became a nationally recognized date, especially among younger consumers and fans of Tex-Mex food. How is National Burrito Day celebrated in the United States? In the United States, National Burrito Day is mainly celebrated with discounts, promotions, and special deals at restaurants. Many chains offer burritos at reduced prices, exclusive combos, or even free items with the purchase of other products. Additionally, brands often launch social media campaigns, contests, and interactive activities to attract customers, while consumers take advantage of the occasion to enjoy their favorite burritos with friends or family. ⇒ SUBSCRIBE TO OUR CONTENT ON GOOGLE NEWS
